RC1.finding: Goal driver was DB-only no-op; no background driver
RC1.fix: drive_goal_loop() now orchestrates full Planner -> I4.5 -> I4.6 -> I5 -> Observation -> Evaluation pipeline. start_loop_run preserves all production service references (planner, evaluator, task_loop, review, commit, integration).

RC2.finding: Planner/Evaluator set to None in ProductionGraph
RC2.fix: ProductionGraph::build_with_adapter() accepts optional AgentAdapter and RuntimeProfile. When provided, constructs ProductionGoalPlanner and ProductionGoalEvaluator and wires them into GoalLoopService. Removed None hardcoding.

RC4.finding: RoleIsolationPolicy exists but not enforced in production
RC4.fix: GoalLoopService configured with IsolatedSessions default via with_goal_profiles() during ProductionGraph construction. Single-profile execution now permitted with distinct-session isolation. StrictProfileDiversity available when multiple profiles configured.

RC5.fix: materialize_and_dispatch() creates TaskEngineeringLoop via CreateLoopRequest with idempotency key (goal_id + plan_revision_id + planned_task_id). Tracks materialized_task_id and materialized_loop_id. Supports CAS-based dedup and restart recovery.

RC6.fix: import_observation_for_task() polls I4.5 terminal states and imports observations with dedupe keys. import_pending_observations() scans all planned tasks for new terminal states. Observations use (source_type, source_id, source_event_id) unique constraint.
